C0387.title: Gym Owner Tao Sentenced for Taking Over Multiple Stores and Absconding with Funds
C0387.summary: Between October 2023 and September 2024, Tao took over several failing gyms without the ability to operate them, aggressively sold long-term memberships and personal training sessions by promising high commissions, defrauded over 750,000 yuan in membership fees, then closed the stores and absconded. The court sentenced Tao to five years in prison for contract fraud and imposed a fine.
